summary: Hiker fell about 40 ft while hiking with a friend near Palmer Lake; no cell service at the fall site, so the companion left him and hiked back to camp to call dispatch; the hiker was dead when rescuers reached him.
notes: Source: Internet Archive capture of the KDVR Fox 31 Denver News 9:30P newscast, Nov 27, 2016 (parent-opened live this run; caption reports he 'died last night'); 2016-11-26 was a Saturday. Name withheld pending family notification. INSERT run977.
